summary: Frontend-only test for the 8 Kobi-Israel-authored journal notes. All acceptance criteria pass: /journal lists 8 cards in artist's intended order (cuba-as-mirror → the-viewer-as-detective); each individual entry page renders the required data-testid blocks (title, subtitle, epigraph in U+2018/U+2019 single quotes, date-location, byline 'By Kobi Israel' rendered as 'BY KOBI ISRAEL' via CSS letter-spacing, body, related, tags); paragraph counts 39–93 per note (all >=30); related links 4–6 per note (all >=3); tag pills 6–8 per note (all >=3); verbatim opening sentences present on all 8 entries; no 'Yaqov' / 'Grossi' / 'Yaqov Israel Grossi' on /journal or any entry page; no placeholder phrases ('Final text to be supplied by the artist', 'Pull quote placeholder', 'Image insert · placeholder', 'Closing paragraph placeholder') on any of the 8 entries. SEO on every entry: <title> ends with 'Kobi Israel Journal', canonical = https://kobiisrael.life/journal/<slug>, robots = 'index, follow', meta description 146–168 chars. Mobile 390x844 shows zero horizontal overflow on /journal and all 8 entry pages. Smoke regression: /, /still, /moving, /prints, /books, /archive, /cv, /contact all render with 0 console errors, unique titles, canonical kobiisrael.life<path>, 2–3 JSON-LD blocks. /projects/cuba-love-story still shows the 5-image cuba sequence + YouTube video facade (youtu.be/2fSc7oPVFOE present in HTML as click-to-play, iframe injected only after click — matches existing pattern from iteration_21).
